policy: One owner per Native setting and per official key; Stage I, Stage G and J4 owners win.
Uncertain mappings stay local; absent or unknown remote values never reset a preference.
Account writes for J6 fields are Off by default (ajustes_oficiais_permitir_escritas), never inherited across contexts.
j1_corrections: AJ_TRAILER_QUAL is not a candidate: trailer_allow_4k is device-local in regular Nuvio.
AJ_FUNDO, AJ_TELA_ABERTURA, AJ_PLR_FORMATO, AJ_LAYOUT_AJUSTES, AJ_PULAR_ABERTURA, AJ_PAUSA_COMENTARIOS and AJ_HERO_NOTAS had matching words but different meaning.
